core_categories: Pharmacy; OTC Healthcare; Beauty and Cosmetics; Convenience and Grocery; Specialty Health Services
specialty_focus: Shoppers Drug Mart is a Canadian retail pharmacy chain (Pharmaprix in Québec) operating over 1,300 associate-owned locations. It combines prescription and OTC health care with beauty, convenience, and specialty patient services, including the Specialty Health Network for complex drug distribution and MediSystem Pharmacy for long-term care. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
key_brands: Life Brand, Quo Beauty, No7, Bone Basics, Google, others
